actions: Query VariantKey::master(real asset); bind physical_generation, fingerprint, image identity, edit revision and recipe digest.
Save exposure1.25 and compare identity before/after; same original fingerprint but new edit revision/digest.
Attempt with_edit_identity using stale identity: callback not invoked, result None.
Query master and created variant separately; metadata edits advance only the applicable image revision.
Source observation change advances shared source epoch/physical generation; source hash remains original.
Decode tiny float TIFF with pixels[-0.25,0.5012345,1.25,1.0] under actual expected BLAKE3 and WhiteBalance::AsShot.
Assert f32 linear channels retain negative/high values and >8bit fractional precision; exact=true and original dimensions2x2.
Wrong fingerprint fails SourceChanged; source file bytes remain unchanged.
Decode actual PNG/TIFF fixture under finite DecodeLimits; preserve orientation/color/provenance.
Exceed encoded/pixel/allocation limits and assert typed ResourceLimit rather than unbounded allocation.
Apply validated exposure+1EV to linear[0.25,0.125,0.5,1] original input; expected RGB doubles before output clipping.
RenderPurpose::ExportExact must reject proxy-only input; cancellation cannot publish partial current output.
Render verified original to caller-owned fresh stage with PNG/JPEG/TIFF OutputSpec and explicit alpha policy.
Compare original BLAKE3 before/after and receipt source_fingerprint, recipe_digest, renderer identity.
Changed source/occupied stage/cancel fails without publishing destination.

metadata-resolution.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Retain fixture.png with two XMP title candidates: Camera and Chosen; collect the real VariantKey and metadata revision.
Read Identity, paged Fields/Candidates/Sources/Observations/Models/Packets/Decisions/FileInstances and all text/blob/import chunks with page limit 2 and chunk length 16.
Resolve the title to Chosen at the recorded revision; repeat with the stale revision.
observables: Changed.revision advances; Fields resolves title Chosen and both candidates remain auditable.
Paged/chunk replies preserve offsets, exact bytes and next cursors; stale Resolve cannot change any stored decision.
faults: Use a foreign catalog token: Reply::Error StaleSession.
Use page limit 0: InvalidRequest; request bytes over configured cap: ResourceLimit.

metadata-write-recovery.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Use fixture.png plus fixture.png.xmp containing title Before; record both original hashes.

Read Options; Start with InputBegin, append exact UTF8 edit document bytes, InputFinish, Prepare/Review and Commit, then SidecarPlan and SidecarApply using returned token/generation/review digest and attempt.
Read InputStatus/Receipt/ReviewFields/Chunk/Plans/Plan/RecoveryEntries; cancel one admitted write and restart the managed session.
observables: Review title After before publication; Receipt identifies the exact operation and target.
Source image hash stays equal; successful sidecar write publishes After once; restart preserves plan/recovery evidence.
faults: Reject stale token/generation/review digest and wrong epoch; no overwrite from a stale review.
Interrupted publication retains recovery evidence instead of reporting successful rollback.

organization-revisions.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Import fixture-a.png and fixture-b.png; create flat keyword LensWorks, hierarchical keyword Travel/Paris, synonym LW and collection Picks.
Apply rating4, Pick flag, Blue label, add/remove/move keywords and collection member edits using current per-image revision.
Begin batch; Append both identities; Seal; Step to completion; read Jobs/Items and Review; exercise Cancel on a second batch.
observables: Queries return the created exact keyword path, synonym and collection placement.
Changed revision advances for each accepted edit; Members contains the intended identities, and batch terminal counts equal two targets.
faults: Stale image revision rejects the edit without changing rating/member rows.
Collection placement cycle and deleting an in-use keyword fail; current rows remain unchanged.

relink-review-identity.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Import fixture-a.png at root-A, record source hashes; copy exact bytes to root-B, then move root-A aside.
Read Rules; Begin with asset scope; Prepare root-B; page Plans/Items/Sources; revise or Confirm with the returned plan revision.
Apply, poll Status, query Original/Mounts, then Undo; Cancel an independently preparing plan.
observables: Review identifies matching fingerprints and the chosen lossless NativePath.
Apply changes catalog locators only; Undo restores prior locator authority; both original copies keep their hashes.
faults: Changed candidate bytes or stale plan revision prevents Apply.
Ambiguous candidates remain unresolved until explicit review; cancellation preserves the previous mapping.

adjustment-transfer.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Import two images and save source exposure1.25/contrast0.2; target exposure-0.5/contrast-0.1.
Begin selecting only Exposure; Append target at real expected revision; Seal with exact total; Inspect and Run; read Jobs/Items.
Cancel a second queued job and reopen catalog to inspect persistent job.
observables: Target exposure becomes1.25 and contrast remains-0.1; target edit revision advances once.
Inspection digest binds the source recipe and selected groups; terminal item counts reflect applied/skipped/conflicted outcomes.
faults: Mutate target recipe after Append; Run reports conflict and preserves newer target.
Active cancellation requires the matching operation id; no overwrite of newer edits.

preview-policy-relocation.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Read Status and SetBudgets with explicit nonzero proxy/thumbnail budgets from Options-compatible bounds.
BeginOriginalRootReview with source root, step exact returned review token with directories2 to completion.
BeginRelocation for thumbnail then large tier to empty cache-B; step tier with objects2 and explicit byte allowance and poll Status; restart.
observables: Status reflects supplied budgets and original-root review progress.
Completed relocation changes the selected tier root; retained items remain discoverable and originals stay outside cache roots.
faults: Overlapping original/cache roots reject admission.
Stale original-root review token or changed storage epoch cannot validate another mapping; StepRelocation selects exact tier.

guarded-migration.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Create a tiny closed Lightroom SQLite fixture and use retained worker fixture documents for every Operation/InputRole.
Begin with exact PartDescriptor byte lengths/digests; Upload ordered UTF8 fragments; Finish each role with computed BLAKE3; Act; poll Status and ResultPage.
Cancel before completion, RetryDrain when required, and Discard only the matching returned Guard; restart and review persisted destination.
observables: Exact Guard/generation remains attached to progress and result pages; uploaded byte totals match documents.
Migration result identities and catalogs preserve supported metadata, collections, history and provenance from the declared documents.
faults: Wrong offset, byte total, digest, role, operation or Guard fails before migration authority is admitted.
Cancel with uncertain drain reports DrainPending; no false successful close/discard.

workbench-input-review.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Use read-only Workbench on a tiny closed Lightroom SQLite fixture; Open returns real workbench/generation; read Options and Status.
Exercise every Action and Query with the required returned revision/evidence; upload Inventory, SelectionRequest, Approval and ApprovalDraft via InputBegin/Append/Finish.
Read Result/SealedDocument/ArtifactPreparation using real tokens and digest approvals; InputDiscard, Cancel and Close; retain source hash.
observables: Queries return bounded rows/chunks under exact selected revision; flattened ResultPage roundtrips without a page key.
PrepareSelection/Seal require matching review token and approval digest; closed source catalog bytes remain identical.
faults: Stale workbench/generation/evidence or wrong input offset rejects the action.
Open read-only never writes source SQLite; Cancel/Close drains before releasing authority.

export-staging-recovery.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Import a tiny RGBA float-capable fixture, record original BLAKE3; read Options, admit an ICC Profile and release it after use.
Begin; resolve Paths/Destinations/DestinationRows; Append a target with exact revision and explicit OutputSize/OutputFormat/Profile/AlphaPolicy/Metadata; Seal exact total.
Run with explicit limits; read Job/Jobs/Items/Plan/PlanChunk/Status; Yield/Cancel a second operation; Recover/RetrySeal/Restore from real recovery authority; release result token.
observables: Retained exports support PNG8/16, JPEG8 with explicit alpha handling and TIFF8/16/float32; export routes never imply PSD/PSB export.
Published receipt binds source fingerprint, recipe/metadata digest, original identity and reviewed destination; reopen retains jobs/items and source hash is identical.
faults: Stale plan authority/source fingerprint or changed destination blocks publication.
Existing output is preserved when overwrite=false; truncated staged output is recoverable and is never reported complete.

catalog-open-close.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Create an empty catalog beneath a temporary root; read real Status.catalog token; Close and OpenExisting same root.
Query Status from an independent job while another request is pending; release all returned owned buffers and jobs.
Close twice according to retained session semantics and drain worker before final handle release.
observables: Status returns a usable catalog token; reopen preserves schema/version and catalog identity.
Transport reaches verified Closed after child/process/callback drain; every owned handle has one release.
faults: Open missing path fails without creating it.
Wrong catalog token returns StaleSession; request after shutdown reports Closed.

import-resume.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Create source root with exactly two tiny PNGs plus an unsupported text file and record every file hash.
Create catalog; ImportStart; poll ImportStatus; cancel one run via returned import id; reopen and ImportResume the same source.
Repeat resume after completion; list Images/Folders.
observables: Exactly two physical assets are retained; unchanged second resume adds no duplicate image identity.
Terminal counters distinguish imported/unchanged/failed/skipped/pending previews; all source hashes are unchanged.
faults: Relative source path is InvalidRequest.
Overlapping import is Busy; wrong import id cannot cancel another operation.

backup-restore-held-jobs.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Create catalog with two images and one pending organization/export job; record source and catalog identity.
BackupCreate into new bundle; poll BackupStatus; BackupInspect verifies actual receipt; BackupRestore into new destination; open restored destination.
RestoreStatus reports held jobs; ResumeRestoredJobs supplies actual restore_id and explicit acknowledgement; cancel a separate backup.
observables: Backup receipt identifies schema/application/database bytes and BLAKE3; restored images and metadata counts match two.
Restored pending jobs stay held until explicit matching acknowledgement; backup includes catalog state, not a relocated original copy.
faults: Wrong restore_id fails; refusal to acknowledge pending jobs leaves jobs held.
Existing restore destination or altered bundle digest fails without replacing existing catalog.

browse-edit-history.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Import two fixture images with different ratings/names; Images/Folders paginate with limit1 and returned cursors.
Search each nondefault filter and Sort/Direction against known metadata; Image/Variants retain exact master/variant keys.
CreateVariant; SaveRecipe exposure1.25 at current revision; Undo; Redo; History; Cull rating4/Blue/Pick using real metadata revision.
observables: Pages retain both identities exactly once; each filter returns the fixture with matching stored value.
Save/Undo/Redo bind recipe digests and advance revision; history persists across close/reopen; master original bytes never change.
faults: Search rating6 or limit0 is InvalidRequest.
Stale edit/metadata revision cannot overwrite a newer recipe or cull.

preview-generation-bytes.setup: Temporary catalog/source/cache roots only; real returned identities/tokens and bounded worker.
actions: Import fixture.png; request thumbnail then proxy with viewport main and increasing generations; poll PreviewStatus.
Copy admitted preview bytes into owned buffer; release viewport and cancel the matching ticket; reopen offline original root after retained preview exists.
Change exposure and request newer generation; drain old generation deliveries.
observables: Bytes are routed to exact ticket/key/revision/recipe digest; late prior-generation result cannot replace current preview.
Offline retained preview remains available with explicit unavailable-original state; browse preview is never accepted as full precision editor input.
faults: Expired/unknown ticket gives StaleSession.
Canceled or superseded viewport request cannot deliver current-generation authority.

actions: Obtain real logical/physical/edit identity through retained Catalog methods.
Change recipe/metadata/source observations separately and retry stale CAS.
observables: Physical fingerprint binds original bytes; logical metadata and edit generations remain independently scoped.
Stale identity callback is not executed.
faults: Invalid VariantKey fails; mixed source/image key is rejected.

actions: Use CPU-only native full TIFF decoder with negative/high fractional f32 pixels and known BLAKE3.
Apply exact retained recipe renderer and stage to a fresh destination.
observables: Linear f32 precision survives; provenance and receipt bind actual source and recipe identities.
Source bytes remain identical and browse JPEG cannot satisfy exact input.
faults: Wrong fingerprint or decoded allocation limit fails before admission.
Cancellation/stale source blocks publication.

actions: For every wire case, deserialize into exact Rust application::Request and Swift LWApplicationRequest.
Serialize Swift request back and deserialize Rust again; compare typed value via JSON tree, including defaults and flattened fields.
observables: Every source enum discriminator and associated field survives its exact serde representation.
Canonical decimal strings and lossless NativePath byte/wide units are preserved.
faults: Unknown enum discriminator/denied unknown field and noncanonical decimal forms fail.
